test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The environment has been ruthlessly destroyed in this area by the growth of industry.

options.text: The environment in this area has ruthlessly destroyed the growth of industry.
The growth of industry has ruthlessly destroyed the environment in this area.
The growth of industry is ruthlessly destroying the environment in this area.
The growth of industry will ruthlessly destroy the environment in this area.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'The growth of industry has ruthlessly destroyed the environment in this area.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice. We have to change the sentence into the active form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present perfect' form. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Passive Voice: Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject
 
• Active Voice: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Passive voice: Chicken curry has been cooked by Sunita for dinner.
 
• Active voice: *Sunita has cooked chicken curry for dinner.*
 
 
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'the environment'** and the subject of the given sentence is **'the growth of industry.'**
 
• So, in the active voice, the position of ‘object’ and ‘subject’ will be interchanged and **'by'** will be removed. 
 
• Also here, 'has been ruthlessly destroyed' will be changed into 'has ruthlessly destroyed.'

 

Correct Sentence:__ *The growth of industry has ruthlessly destroyed the environment in this area.*
